__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. Its SHAPE is the one the survey records from the read-only call of 5 October 2026 against a live OPNsense 26.7 with gateway monitoring disabled; every VALUE in it was written by hand, and no part of that response was copied here. Do not treat this file as evidence of any firewall's gateways.
__provenance__.survey_section: Gateway status, read from source for step 5
__provenance__.field_list_from: items[] each with name, address, status, loss, delay, stddev, monitor and status_translated, and a top-level status, in the shape the live call of 5 October 2026 returned and opnsense/core 26.7.3 dpinger.inc, dpinger_status, writes: status none and loss, delay and stddev ~ for a gateway no dpinger process monitors
__provenance__.why_these_values: Two gateways, one per address family, neither monitored: every figure is ~ and the status is none, as dpinger_status leaves them when the gateway's monitoring is disabled. The collector must write no reading and must name the absence as gateways listed with no figure.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every name and address below is synthesised for this fixture. None of them describes anyone's network, and no code under test presupposes any of them: each is read back out of this file.
